content: {"episode_id":"ep-05050","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity reconsideration is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), denied under CO-197 with authorization missing.
